ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to E Asian Languages & Cultures or Teaching of Russian or Teaching of French or Teaching of German or Teaching of Spanish or Teaching of Latin major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Early field experiences require Illinois State Criminal Background Check (see Council on Teacher Education for questions) and annual Bloodborne Pathogen Training. Includes 28 hours of Early Field Experiences in area schools. Students must reserve one block of 4 consecutive hours each week.
